svg.title: A high-frequency stability diagnostic
svg.desc: For pure diffusion the alternating-cell mode has amplification 1−4 mu per Euler step. At mu 0.4 its magnitude decays; at mu 0.6 it grows. The production solver rejects the latter time step.
